# test-plan.md - Artifact Contract

Produced by: Test Plan Generator (Skill 3)
Consumed by: Test Case Documenter (Skill 4)

This file is the authoritative, append-only scenario catalog for one request. It is derived exclusively from `requirements.md` and `exploration.md` - never from Jira, Confluence, or the live application directly.
